title: Claude Code Cant Design - Google Stitch Fixes It for Free
description:
Claude Code writes great code but struggles with front end design. Google Stitch is a free AI tool that generates beautiful full UI designs from a plain English description. Connect it to Claude Code via MCP and one prompt turns all your screens into production-ready code with smooth animations. 

Get the Claude + Stitch guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/10brFHITBC6_zf_90Jg77qyvBS-gI9EJn/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110897400342351178452&rtpof=true&sd=true

#ClaudeCode #GoogleStitch #AIDesign #UIDesign #AITools
